name: Riko
source:
"I really wanted to give this to you… Senpai."

The sender of the chocolate that was quietly slipped into the shoe box. What are her true feelings as she hides her presence and watches over the protagonist from afar…? The answer will be revealed amid the twists of Valentine’s Day fate—!?

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250518184944/https://g.28gou.net/valentinus/#characters]official website[/url]]
